Gossip Protocol — Scale Without Coordinator in 60s  #systemdesign #coding #ai #software #scortier
entries.summary: A short explainer on the Gossip Protocol in distributed systems, showing how nodes in a cluster share state without a central coordinator — used by Cassandra for membership, Consul for health checks, and BitTorrent for peer discovery. Information spreads in log N rounds, making the approach resilient and massively scalable.

AirLLM enables local 70B AI #airllm #flashattention #llama3
entries.summary: AirLLM is an open-source Python library that lets developers run 70B-parameter models like LLaMA 3.3 on consumer hardware (MacBook, gaming PC) by streaming model layers from disk one at a time instead of loading the entire model into memory. Comments note a significant speed tradeoff — roughly 1 token per second — making it practical primarily for offline batch jobs and privacy-first research rather than interactive use.
